utilities.card.translator.body: Translate text, visible image text, audio, and video under account-based limits.
translator.intro: Translate text, image text, audio, and video. OpenAI credentials remain on the Timeblock server.
translator.login_body: This utility is available to Timeblock members and business accounts under the limits of the current plan.

translator.audio.note: Audio, MP4, and WebM are supported. Audio and video are charged against their matching plan meters.
